paragraphs.text: Fifteen cards in Alchemy: Edge of Eternities feature flavor text not visible on the cards themselves but rather in a separate pop-up box. These are not listed on Scryfall .

The ten check lands have the flavor text of their printing in either Dominaria or Ixalan . Five of the designed-for-digital cards have flavor text expanding on Tezzeret 's opinion of, and place within, the Edge .
